zeroconf_confirm.description:
Add the Stream Deck Network Dock at {host}?

Attached deck: {deck}

menu_options.dock: Add a Stream Deck Network Dock
menu_options.bridge: Add a Stream Assistant Bridge (Stream Decks on a computer)

dock.description: Enter the IP address of your Elgato Stream Deck Network Dock. Make sure no other software (Stream Deck app, Companion) is connected to it.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Network Dock.

bridge.title: Stream Assistant Bridge
bridge.description: Address of the computer running the Stream Assistant Bridge. Bridges in the same network are found automatically.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Enter the 6-digit pairing code the bridge at {host} shows (its window, log, or http://localhost:{port} on that computer).

hassio_confirm.title: Stream Assistant Bridge add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the Stream Decks of the add-on {name}? It is paired already, no code is needed.

virtual.title: Virtual panel
virtual.description: A Stream Deck that only exists in Home Assistant: keys, pages, templates and automations work like on a real deck, shown by the "Stream Assistant panel" dashboard card (wall tablet, phone). Choose any grid size.

data_description.name: Name of the device, e.g. "Kitchen tablet".

planner.title: Only plan (no hardware yet)
planner.description: Enables the Stream Assistant editor in the sidebar without a dock. Plan templates for your future Stream Decks there and assign them once the hardware is set up. You can keep this entry or remove it later.

reconfigure.title: Change grid
reconfigure.description: Keys keep their row and column. Keys outside the new grid are removed.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge at {host} no longer accepts Home Assistant (it was reset or the pairing was removed). Enter the pairing code it shows now.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the dock. Check the address and that no other software is connected to it.
error.cannot_connect_bridge: Cannot reach the bridge. Check the address and that the bridge is running.
error.invalid_code: Wrong pairing code. After 5 wrong codes the bridge waits a minute.
error.wrong_bridge: This code belongs to a different bridge.

abort.not_network_dock: This device is not a Stream Deck Network Dock.
abort.not_reconfigurable: Only virtual panels can be reconfigured.

set_key.name: Set key
set_key.description: Changes what a Stream Deck key shows. The layout is stored and restored after reconnects and restarts.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text shown on the key, may contain line breaks.

font_size.name: Font size
font_size.description: Font size in pixels. Default depends on the key size.

image.name: Image
image.description: Path to an image file on the Home Assistant host, scaled to fill the key.

clear_key.name: Clear key
clear_key.description: Blanks a Stream Deck key and removes its stored appearance.

init.title: Bridge options
init.description: Automatic updates: when Stream Assistant is updated, the bridge installs the matching version on its own (only bridges that can update themselves).
